result.design:
# Tests, the start sheet and the test window

What this covers: `/tests/` (your score, what to sit, what's unfinished, every sitting), the **start sheet**, and `/test/` (lobby and fullscreen gate, questions, navigator, Check your work, between modules, time's up, Save and exit, resume). Items marked **(extra)** are things TopTierPrep doesn't have.

**Ground rules for this section**
- **Behaviour is Bluebook's**, so test day holds no surprises: one module at a time; answers can change until the module is handed in; mark for review; eliminate; navigator; Check your work; no way back into a handed-in module; a clock that can be hidden, with a 5-minute warning.
- **The look is the practice session's**, which is the user's pick. Paper white. A centred 700px column. Source Serif 4 stems at 20px. Warm `--tile` options with circled letters. DM Mono for clocks and counts. A sticky top bar and a sticky footer. The Bluebook dashed rules, the black number square and the ruled question strip go: they are College Board trade dress, and the teardown says to copy the behaviour, not the chrome.
- **Orange is the only accent.** It marks the selected answer, marked-for-review, and the live or recommended thing. Answered is graphite (`--ink`). Destructive actions are graphite behind a confirm sheet, never red.
- **Labels everywhere.** Every tool has a label (icon only below 760px, with an `aria-label` and a tooltip). Legends carry counts. Short helper lines appear where they help a student decide. No decorative copy.
- **Nothing a student does is lost.** Answers, marks, eliminations, highlights, notes and time per question live on the server. They come back after a reload or on another device with the same code.

---

## 1. One runner shell for tests and practice

The test window and the practice session become **one shell**, in `web/assets/runner.js` and `runner.css`, with a `mode` switch. The shell keeps the practice session's look and adds a sticky footer that both modes use (TopTierPrep's QBank session has the same bottom bar: Previous · Question N of 10 · Check/Next).

| region | practice (`mode:'practice'`) | test (`mode:'exam'`) |
|---|---|---|
| top-left | × End set | × Save and exit · title "Math · Module 1 of 2" · Directions ⌄ |
| top-centre | progress strip (right = amber, wrong = ink) + "4 / 10" | clock `34:57` + Hide; progress strip under it (answered / unanswered / marked / current) |
| top-right | Timer (if timed) · Save · Calculator · Reference · More | Annotate · Calculator · Reference · More |
| question header | skill glyph + skill + difficulty + mastery bar · Save · Eliminate · Report | `Q7` badge · Mark for review · Eliminate · Report |
| choosing an option | locks; the key, the named mistake and the rationale appear | selects (can change), saved, nothing revealed |
| footer | Previous · "Question 3 of 10 ⌃" · Check / Next | Back · "Question 7 of 22 ⌃" · Next / Review |
| navigator | Status (unanswered / right / wrong / mixed / saved / current) or Difficulty | answered / unanswered / for review / current, with filters |
| end | summary | Check your work → next module, or hand in → report |

Sizes (desktop): top bar 64px; progress strip 16px hit area with 4px segments; column `max-width:700px`, top padding `clamp(20px,5vh,48px)`, bottom padding 120px; footer 68px. Phone (<760px): top bar 56px, footer 64px plus `env(safe-area-inset-bottom)`, side gutters 16px.

---

## 2. `/tests/`

### 2.1 Desktop layout (1280, content max 1120)

```
[shell bar]
Tests                                                  How scoring works (quiet)
Every test is built when you start it, from questions you haven't seen.
┌ T1 Estimated score (2fr) ─────────────────────┐ ┌ T2 Up next (1fr) ──────┐
└───────────────────────────────────────────────┘ └────────────────────────┘
┌ T3 In progress (full width, only when any) ─────────────────────────────┐
Start a test
┌ T4 card ┐ ┌ T4 card ┐ ┌ T4 card ┐      (3 columns ≥1000px, 2 at 600–999, 1 below)
┌ T4 card ┐ ┌ T4 card ┐ ┌ T4 card ┐
Your sittings  12                        [Kind ▾][Status ▾][Timing ▾][Sort ▾] Clear
T5 rows…                                                          Show 20 more
```

### 2.2 T1: Estimated score card (`#score`)
- `--tile` card, radius 14px, padding 24px, laid out in two columns.
- **Left column:**
  - `k` label "Estimated Math score".
  - Band, e.g. "560–700" (`.num`, `clamp(48px,6vw,72px)`).
  - Delta chip (DM Mono 13px, `--wash` background) "+40 since Sep 12". Hidden when there is only one scored sitting.
  - Source line (meta): "Full section #4 · Sep 23 · harder module 2", plus "· 580 cap" when capped.
- **Right column:** a mini band chart of the last 8 scored sittings, 120px tall. It uses the Results chart as `UI.bandChart(host, sittings, {height:120})`, and the newest band is orange. Under the chart sit three fact rows (label in `k`, value in 600 15px):
  - "Best" 580–720.
  - "Combined, last 3 sections" 590–690 **(extra)**. Shown when there are ≥2 full sections. It averages the midpoints, with half-width 70/√n rounded to 10; the "How scoring works" sheet explains it.
  - "Target" 700, with "(Plan)" linking to `/plan/`. When no target is set: "Set a target" linking to `/plan/`.
  - "Exam" "Oct 3 · 10 days", from the profile. The row is hidden when there is no exam date.
- **Empty (no scored sitting):**
  - Band "—".
  - Line: "No estimate yet. A full section gives a band about 140 points wide; one module or the diagnostic, about 200."
  - The chart area shows the 200–800 axis with no bands.
- **Loading:** skeleton blocks (`--tile-2`) in the band and chart spots.
- **Error:** "Couldn't load your score." plus a quiet "Retry".

### 2.3 T2: Up next (`#next`) (coach and plan tie-in)
- `--wash` card, radius 14px, padding 22px. Contents: `k` "Up next", a title (700 18px), a meta line, and one pill.
- What it recommends, in this order:
  1. An unfinished sitting exists: "Finish Full section #12", with a "Resume" pill.
  2. Today is a plan test day (`UI.plan.dayOf(today, profile)` = 'test') and `today.tested` is false:
     - Title "Today's test: full section" (or "module" when `plan.testOf(minutes)` = 'module').
     - Meta "44 questions · 70 min".
     - Pill "Start". It opens the start sheet preset and focused on Start.
  3. Brand-new learner (no attempts): "Start with the diagnostic", meta "20 questions · 32 min · all four domains evenly", pill "Start".
  4. Otherwise: "Full section", meta "Your last was 9 days ago" (or "Next test day: Saturday" when a plan exists), pill "Start".
- Under the pill, when no plan is set: quiet "Plan your test days", linking to `/plan/`.

### 2.4 T3: In progress (`#live`)
- Shown only when unfinished, non-discarded test sittings exist. Up to 3 rows, newest first. Each row is a `--wash` tile, radius 12px, padding 16px 18px, grid `1fr auto`.
- **Left side:**
  - Title "Full section #12" (700 15.5px).
  - Meta: "Module 1 of 2 · 14 of 22 answered · 3 marked".
  - State line (DM Mono 13px), one of:
    - "Paused · 21:40 left"
    - "Clock running · 12:03 left", when the student left without Save and exit (the clock kept going)
    - "Time ran out · answers saved"
    - "Untimed · 18 min so far"
  - Started (meta): "Started today 9:14".
- **Right side:** pill "Resume" (label "Continue" when time ran out), quiet "Hand in", quiet "Discard".
  - Hand in: opens `/test/?s=ID#review`.
  - Discard: confirm sheet "Discard Full section #12? Its 14 answers won't count anywhere. This can't be undone." with [Keep it] [Discard], then `POST /api/session/{id}/discard` and the row animates out.

### 2.5 T4: Start a test (`#kinds`), the catalog cards
- Each `.kind` card: `--tile` background, radius 14px, padding 20px 20px 18px, a flex column with gap 14px.
- **Header row:** title (700 17px) and a flag icon button (36px, `aria-label` "Report a problem with this test") that opens UI.report with `context:'catalog'`.
- **Tags row:** chips 26px high, radius 8px, 600 12px, `--paper` background. The "Adaptive" tag uses a `--wash` background.
- **Facts line** (DM Mono 13px, ink).
- **Stat tiles:** two or three `.stat` tiles, each a `k` label plus a 600 17px value.
  - "Everyone": "1,284 sittings". Once ≥30 scored sittings of that kind exist, a second line appears: "Your last beats 62%".
  - "You": last result, or "Not taken".
  - "Best": best band, or "—".
- **Actions row:** a Start button, and quiet "Options" (opens the start sheet at that kind's step 2).
  - The recommended card (the same kind as T2) gets the orange pill.
  - Other cards get `.btn-2`: a 44px button with `--paper` background, ink text and radius 999px. They are not orange, so the grid doesn't become six orange pills.

The cards, in order:

1. **Full section**
   - Tags: Adaptive · Official timing · 15/15/7/7 blueprint
   - Facts: "44 questions · 70 min · 2 modules"
   - Stats: Everyone / You (band) / Best
2. **Module 1**
   - Tags: Mixed difficulty · Official timing
   - Facts: "22 questions · 35 min"
   - Stats: Everyone / You ("17/22") / Best
3. **Module 2 · harder** (the upper module, fixed)
   - Tags: Fixed · Leans hard
   - Facts: "22 questions · 35 min"
   - Helper (12.5px soft): "What a strong module 1 earns you."
4. **Module 2 · easier** (the lower module, fixed)
   - Tags: Fixed · Leans easy
   - Facts: "22 questions · 35 min"
5. **Custom test (extra)**
   - Tags: Your skills · Test rules
   - Facts: "5–60 questions · you choose"
   - Helper: "No answers until you hand in, like a real module."
   - Start opens the start sheet at the custom step. There is no one-tap start.
6. **Diagnostic**
   - Tags: All four domains evenly
   - Facts: "20 questions · 32 min"
   - Helper: "Asks for your name and email before the result."
7. **Twin of your last test (extra)**
   - Only when a finished section or module exists.
   - Title "Twin of Full section #11".
   - Tags: Same slots · New numbers
   - Facts: "44 questions · 70 min"
   - Helper: "Every question is the same kind, at the same difficulty and position, with new numbers. An equal test, to see whether you've improved."
   - Stats: "Original" band.

There is deliberately no Access filter and no lock state: everything is free. Their "Predictions" papers have no equivalent (see open questions).

### 2.6 T5: Your sittings (`#sittings`)
- **Header:** `k` "Your sittings", a count (DM Mono), then the filter bar `#filters`.
- **Filter bar.** Each control is `UI.dropdown`: a button showing the label in `k` style and the value in 600 14px underneath (their "Sort By · Newest" pattern). It opens a listbox menu with radio items and a check. Esc closes it and arrow keys move.
  - **Kind:** All / Full sections / Modules / Custom / Diagnostics / Twins.
  - **Status:** All / Completed / In progress / Timed out.
  - **Timing:** All / Official / Extended / Untimed.
  - **Sort:** Newest / Oldest / Highest / Lowest. Unscored rows sort last for Highest and Lowest.
  - "Clear" (quiet) shows when any filter isn't All.
  - Filters are written to the URL (`?kind=section&sort=high`) and to localStorage `satf.tests.filters`, with every access wrapped in try/catch.
- **Row (desktop):** a grid `44px 120px minmax(0,1.2fr) 150px 70px 70px 90px minmax(0,1.4fr) auto`, padding 14px 16px, radius 10px, `--tile` hover. The columns:
  - `#12` (DM Mono).
  - Date "Sep 23 · 9:14" (DM Mono 12.5px soft).
  - Kind "Full section", with sub "Adaptive · official" (12px soft).
  - Score: "560–700" (800 17px), or "17/22" for unscored kinds, or "Practice" for kinds that give no estimate. Chips under it: "Harder M2" or "Easier M2" when a route is set, and "580 cap".
  - M1 "17/22".
  - M2 "15/22" ("—" for a single module).
  - Time "64 min", or "Untimed · 81 min".
  - Misses: small ink chips with white numbers, one group per module, e.g. "M1 3 8 14 · M2 2 9 +4" (at most 8 chips, then "+N"). A chip links to `/results/report/?id=ID&q=M1-3`.
  - Actions (quiet buttons): "Review", "Fix 7" (only when there are misses; `POST /api/drill {from_session}`, then the session page), "Twin", and "Note" (see below).
- **Note (extra):** a private note to self per sitting, e.g. "ran out of time on 18–22".
  - When a note exists it shows as a second line in the row, in italic serif 14px.
  - Editing happens inline: a textarea with 0/1000 and Save / Cancel, sent with `PUT /api/session/{id}/note`.
  - This stands in for their comments (see extras).
- **Try the other module 2 (extra).** On a section that routed lower, an action "Try the harder module 2" starts a single upper module 2.
- **In-progress rows** appear here too when Status is All or In progress, with Resume in place of Review.
- **Pagination:** 20 rows, then "Show 20 more".
- **States:**
  - Loading: 4 skeleton rows.
  - Empty, new student: "Nothing sat yet. Your first full section gives your first score estimate."
  - Filtered empty: "No sittings match these filters." plus "Clear filters".
  - Error: "Couldn't load your sittings." plus Retry.

### 2.7 T6: How scoring works (`#howScored` sheet) (extra)
A plain-language version of scoring.py/README. It covers:
- The ordinal heuristic, which is not IRT.
- The band widths: ±70 for a section, ±100 for a module or the diagnostic.
- The route cut at 60% of module 1.
- The 580 ceiling on the easier module 2.
- That harder, easier and custom tests show "Practice, not a score estimate".
- That extended time shows its estimate with "extended time" beside it.

### 2.8 Phone (390)
Everything is one column with 16px gutters and no horizontal scroll.
- **T1:** the band at 48px. The chart sits below the band at full width, 110px tall. The fact rows form a 2-up grid.
- **T2** and **T3** stack.
- **T4** cards are one column, with Start and Options side by side.
- **Filter bar:** the four dropdowns in a 2×2 grid, with "Clear" under them.
- **T5 row as a card:**
  - Line 1: `#12 · Sep 23` and the score on the right.
  - Line 2: kind · M1 17/22 · M2 15/22 · 64 min.
  - Line 3: miss chips, wrapping (at most 6 plus "+N").
  - Line 4: actions.
- The dropdown menus open as bottom sheets.

---

## 3. The start sheet (`#start`, `dialog.sheet`, 640px; a full-height sheet on a phone)

- **Header:** title "Start a test", a close X, and a stepper of 4 segments (4px bars, amber when done or current) with labels under them: Test · Modules · Timing · Tools.
- **Footer:** quiet "Back"; a summary line in DM Mono, e.g. "Full section · adaptive · 44 questions · 70 min"; and the pill "Next" or "Start".
- **Behaviour:**
  - Start becomes available from step 2 on; Tools is optional.
  - Enter moves forward, Esc closes.
  - The last choices are remembered in localStorage `satf.tests.last` and preselected next time.
  - Deep link: `/tests/?start=section|module1|module2u|module2l|custom|diagnostic|twin` opens the sheet preset. Today and Plan use this link.

**Step 1 · "What do you want to sit?"**
Radio cards in a 2×3 grid (one column on a phone), each with a title and a facts line: Full section / Choose modules / Custom test / Diagnostic / Twin of #11 (only when there is a source). The diagnostic goes straight to Start, with no Modules or Tools steps.

**Step 2 · Modules** (depends on step 1)
- **Full section.** Two segmented controls:
  - "Module 2": **Adaptive** (like the SAT) / **Always harder** / **Always easier**. This is their Adaptive vs Non-adaptive.
  - "Module 1": **Standard** / **Harder** / **Easier** **(extra)**. Harder and Easier use the new tiers `module1_upper` (easy 3 / medium 8 / hard 11) and `module1_lower` (11/8/3). This is their Difficulty filter.
  - Helper line, only when it applies: "Harder or easier module 1 is practice, not a score estimate." A fixed module 2 with a standard module 1 still gets an estimate, using that route's rules. The helper says so: "Scored as if module 1 had routed you there."
- **Choose modules.** This is their Select Modules.
  - Checkable cards: "Module 1 · 22 questions · 35 min · mixed", "Module 2 · harder · 22 questions · 35 min", "Module 2 · easier · …". The two module 2 cards exclude each other.
  - "Select all" checks Module 1 and Module 2 harder. "Clear" unchecks everything.
  - A counter: "2 of 2 modules · 44 questions · 70 min".
  - Choosing Module 1 plus a module 2 becomes a section with that fixed route. At least one card must be checked, or Start stays disabled with the note "Pick at least one module".
- **Custom test (extra):**
  - Skills picker: 4 domain groups of skill chips (`UI.chip` with glyph). A domain header toggles all of its skills. An open-mistake dot sits on each chip.
  - Presets: "Weak spots" (the coach's `ahead[0]` plus open-mistake topics), "All", "Clear".
  - Length: 10 / 22 / 44, plus a number field (5–60).
  - Order: "Easiest first, like a module" / "Mixed".
  - Formats: Both / Multiple choice only / Grid-in only.
  - Difficulty: Easy / Medium / Hard toggles, at least one.
  - Live line: "22 questions · 35:00 at test pace".
  - Start stays disabled until ≥1 skill is picked.
- **Twin.** No choices. Shows the source ("Full section #11 · Sep 12 · 520–660") and "Same 44 slots, new numbers".

**Step 3 · Timing**
Radio cards, each with a title and the resulting clock:
- **Official:** "35:00 a module" (custom: "95 s a question · 35:00").
- **Time and a half (extra):** "52:30 a module".
- **Double time (extra):** "70:00 a module".
- **Untimed:** "The clock counts up, so you still see your time".
- Custom only: **My own minutes**, a number field of 1–180.

**Step 4 · Tools** (defaults shown)
- Fullscreen: on.

## 4. `/test/`: the test window

|---|---|---|
| Loading | fetching the session | — |
| Lobby | `begun:false` (fresh, or module 2 not yet begun), or paused | `#lobby` |
| Question | live | `#q7` |
| Check your work | from Next on the last question, the navigator or More | `#review` |
| Between modules | module 1 of a section handed in, module 2 not begun | `#between` |

| Handing in | final finish in flight | — |
| Problem | 404 / 403 / network | — |

## 5. Flows (calls)

1. **Start.** Start sheet → `POST /api/mock/new {…}` → `/test/?s=ID` → `GET /api/session/ID` returns `begun:false` → lobby → Begin (plus `requestFullscreen`) → `POST /begin` → `GET` returns the questions → Q1, with Directions on the first start.
2. **Answer.** Select → `POST /api/session/ID/answer {question_id, answer}`. Mark, strike, highlight, note and time all go through `POST /api/session/ID/state {question_id, …}`.
3. **Review and move on.**
   - Last question → Next ("Review") → `#review`, with no server call.
   - Move on → `POST /finish`, which returns `{next_module:2, summary}` → `#between` → Begin module 2 → `POST /begin` → `GET` → module 2, Q1.
4. **Hand in.** `POST /finish` → `{finished}` → the report.
5. **Clock runs out.** The client calls `POST /finish` → `#timeup`.
6. **Save and exit.** `POST /pause` → `/tests/`.
7. **Resume.** Tests → Resume → the paused lobby → `POST /begin`.
8. **Discard.** `POST /discard`.
9. **From the history.** Twin → `POST /api/mock/new {twin_of}`. Fix → `POST /api/drill {from_session}`.

server.detail: New sittings are inserted with module_started NULL and cfg.lobby=true. remaining(): if cfg.lobby and module_started is NULL, it returns the full duration. POST /begin sets module_started=now() when it is NULL, or clears a pause (see below). It is idempotent and returns payload(row). Diagnostics (POST /api/session) take the same path. Older rows without cfg.lobby keep today's behaviour.

New columns: sessions.paused_at TEXT, paused_ms INTEGER DEFAULT 0, pauses INTEGER DEFAULT 0. POST /api/session/{sid}/pause sets paused_at=now() and pauses+=1, only when it is live, timed and unfinished; it is idempotent. POST /begin on a paused row adds now−paused_at to paused_ms and clears paused_at. remaining() subtracts paused_ms, plus now−paused_at while paused. paused_ms resets to 0 when module 2 begins.
